messages:
sophia: Quick pre-cut sanity check — we cutting v1.8.0 from `release/1.8.0` right? changelog updated, version bumped in package.json?
marco: Yep branch is up to date, bump landed in #4123 and merged. Changelog has the shortnotes section.
raj: I’ll handle tagging/pushing after artifacts are confirmed uploaded. I have the annotated tag script ready.
tina: Infra: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/v1.8.0/ earlier, CI passed. Will verify checksums now.
ci-bot: Build 1187 — all checks green. Artifacts: release.tar.gz (1.2GB), checksums.txt uploaded. Logs: https://ci.redwood/inv/1187
emily: I can create the draft release on GH and attach assets once checksums are verified. Tagging preference — signed annotated tag or plain annotated?
sophia: Prefer signed annotated for releases, but if signing blocks CI we can do annotated + CI verified checksum. Also need final one-line changelog entry from product. @emily can you add that?
emily: On it, will add final line.
raj: Tagging command I’m going to run (local sign):
```
# create signed annotated tag
git tag -s v1.8.0 -m "v1.8.0 — release: production rollout"
git push origin v1.8.0
```
raj: If CI signs artifacts with sigstore we can rely on that too. For now I’ll do GPG-signed tag.
tina: Verifying checksums: running `shasum -a 256 release.tar.gz` -> matches checksums.txt. Upload verified.
marco: Cutoff reminder — feature freeze at 18:00 UTC. We should not accept any new PRs into release branch after that.
sophia: Noted. Any pending cherry-picks?
emily: Two small docfix cherry-picks approved, not risky. I’ll merge them before cutoff.
raj: Pushing tag in 5m after emily confirms draft assets attached. Will leave a hold if anything pops.
emily: Draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/draft — assets attached and checksums added to the body. Dropped the one-line changelog. Please sanity check.
sophia: Quick smoke test suggestion for staging route: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/health` should return 200 and body {"ok":true}.
marco: smoke looks good from my side. 200, ok true.
raj: Tag pushed: `git push origin refs/tags/v1.8.0` — pushed and signed.
release-manager-bot: Received tag v1.8.0 and draft release. Publish window open at 18:10 UTC. React with :hand: to hold, :white_check_mark: to publish.
marco: :white_check_mark:
sophia: :white_check_mark:
tina: :white_check_mark:
emily: :white_check_mark:
raj: All good from my end. @release-manager-bot please proceed with publish at scheduled time.
release-manager-bot: Acknowledged — will publish at 18:10 UTC unless a hold reaction is added. Auto-notify to #general when published.
sophia: Thanks team — I’ll kick off the post-publish smoke and rollout notes once published.
marco: Nice work, minimal churn.
emily: small follow-up: I left the draft release body with links to the changelog snippet and the checksums file. If someone wants extra release notes, add inline to the draft.
tina: Uploading provenance and SLSA attestation now, should be available on the draft assets.
raj: One last FYI — if publishing fails due to GitHub rate limits, plan B is to send assets + tag to release-manager and we’ll do a manual publish.
sophia: Good call. Keep me posted.
emily: Will report back in thread once publish done.
release-manager-bot: Published v1.8.0 at 18:10 UTC — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.8.0
emily: Published and promoted to release channel.
sophia: Confirmed release tag and assets visible. Rolling out traffic now. :rocket:
marco: :thumbsup:
raj: :thumbsup:
tina: :thumbsup:
